verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs explicitly describe an 'OAuth implementation' where the developer's app can act as the OAuth provider, granting third-party applications scoped access to a user's data via Clerk's API — this is the core of 'Sign in with my app.' However, the evidence pack gives only a brief overview of scoped access and no detailed walkthrough of token issuance, client registration, or grant/consent flows, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of this working in practice. missing for 10: detailed OAuth-provider setup/token-issuance docs, third-party client registration flow, independent corroboration of the provider mode working.
